## History

Clair Donnell was a student in Anne's classroom who brought a package of firecrackers to school. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was already in a foul mood due to a toothache, the firecrackers accidentally exploded, contributing to a disaster-filled day for the schoolteacher.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P6](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0006), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P8](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0008), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P10](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P12](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0012), +21 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--clair-donnell.md)

Clair Donnell is a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) teaches. During a tumultuous day caused by Anne's severe toothache, Clair brings a package of firecrackers to class, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sets off while trying to burn them in the stove.

- Student of — teacher and student  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P6](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0006)</sub>
